$comment: Reference copy of the release manifest. The LIVE copy does not belong in this repo —
the core repo is private, and every publisher install fetches the manifest daily without
credentials. Publish it from a small PUBLIC repo (e.g. abh2-lab/cms-releases) and point
UPDATE_MANIFEST_URL at its raw URL. It carries version numbers and links only.
Parser rules (apps/worker/src/lib/update-check.ts):
- Either a bare array or { releases: [...] } is accepted, so top-level fields can be
added later without breaking older installs.
- Unknown fields are ignored; a malformed entry is dropped, not fatal.
- Order does not matter — entries are sorted by version before comparison.
- version and type are required. An entry missing either is skipped.
notes_url MUST point somewhere PUBLIC. A link into the private core repo's releases
page 404s for every publisher who clicks it — point at the CHANGELOG in this same
public repo instead.
See docs/phase-3-versioning-and-updates-plan.md.

releases.$comment: Example of a normal code release — no migrations, nothing to prepare.

$comment: Example of a release that runs migrations. type:'schema' forces requires_backup
true in the worker regardless of what is written here, and the admin shows the
stricter banner. new_env_vars are surfaced in that banner because @cms/config
exits the container at boot when a required var is missing — better a checklist
than a crash loop.
min_upgrade_from means the install must ALREADY be running that version. An
install on 1.0.0 is offered 1.1.0 first, not this one.
